9904 booking@gmpremiumhotel.com 41 Hang Bong Street, Hoan Kiem District, Hanoi 100000 Book Room About GM Welcome to GM Premium Hotel, the epitome of luxury in Hanoi's Old Quarter. Located in the heart of the ancient Silk Street, our hotel is ideally situated just 500 meters from the picturesque Hoan Kiem Lake, Night market and a mere 300 meters from the iconic St. Joseph's Cathedral. 5-star establishment GM Premium offers 60 beautifully appointed rooms, each featuring a private balcony, allowing for an abundance of natural light to illuminate the space. Our rooms are equipped with modern amenities to ensure your utmost comfort and convenience.For your dining pleasure, we boast a diverse array of culinary experiences. Start your day with a delectable breakfast that includes a variety of Vietnamese, European, American, Asian, and Vegetarian options. Join us for dinner as well, where our talented chefs prepare an array of mouthwatering dishes. Don't miss our Sky Bar, offering panoramic views of Hanoi's Old Quarter and a breathtaking sunset view each evening. Your well-being To enhance your well-being, we provide a spa with expert therapists, offering a range of therapeutic and relaxation treatments. Additionally, we have a sauna and mineral bath for your ultimate relaxation and not to mention a fitness centre equipped of multi-functional facilities designed to provide convenience and comfort to travelers who want to maintain their fitness routines while away from home. Service from the heart At GM Premium, we understand the importance of exploring the cultural treasures of Hanoi. That's why we offer 24/7 services to help you discover the city's hidden gems. Our dedicated team of professionals is committed to providing you with exceptional service from the heart. We look forward to making your stay at GM Premium a truly memorable experience.
